question: GHCN-Daily snow, precipitation and temperature stations for Montana, 2020 to 2026: station counts, units and flags, named-station metrics, daily budget, station rule test, SNODAS option.
bottom_line: GHCN-Daily gives usable station history for Montana, but the S3 by-station CSV files are not current for two networks. All 89 SNOTEL and all 25 airport (WBAN) Montana files end on 2025-02-06 in S3 (Last-Modified 2025-02-09), while the NCEI all/<ID>.dly copies of the same stations run to 2026-10-16. Use the NCEI files. Snow totals come from airport, COOP and CoCoRaHS stations; SNOTEL sites report depth, not snowfall. SNODAS is not practical for a five-year backfill (about 21.8 GB estimated against a 300 MB budget).
recommendation: 1) Source: read NCEI https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/ghcn/daily/all/<ID>.dly (complete and current for all 481 Montana stations with a 2025 record: 392.2 MB in full; 33.7 MB for the 45 stations within 40 miles of the two sample points). Use S3 csv.gz for COOP and CoCoRaHS only after checking it against the .dly (checked so far: the Billings airport csv.gz equals its csv, and two CoCoRaHS csv files equal their .dly; csv.gz against .dly not yet checked for COOP or CoCoRaHS). Never use S3 by-station files for SNOTEL or WBAN stations until S3 catches up. Mark any station not current when its newest report is more than 30 days old (proposed). 2) Station rule, per element and per location: candidates are Montana stations within 40 miles (great-circle) with a report in the last 30 days; coverage is days with an unflagged value over days in 2020 to 2025 (2,192 days), at least 80 percent; take the two nearest that pass. If fewer than two pass, show those that pass and say so; if none pass, show that no station qualifies. Never fill a gap with zero. Test result: the Billings point gets Billings WTP COOP USC00240802 (1.4 mi) and Billings Logan USW00024033 (2.6 mi) for all five elements; the two nearest CoCoRaHS sites fail (snow 59 and 31 percent, depth 1 and 3 percent). The Benchland point gets different pairs by element: snow Buffalo 1.7 E US1MTFG0003 (20.9 mi, 81.7 percent) and Lewistown 11 SSE USC00244978 (31.1 mi, 90.0 percent); depth Stanford USC00247864 (10.9 mi, 81.9 percent) and Crystal Lake SNOTEL USS0009C01S (31.3 mi, 99.9 percent); precipitation and temperatures Stanford (10.9 mi, 96 to 97 percent) and Lewistown 42 WSW USW00004140 (18.5 mi, 100 and 99.8 percent). The 80 percent cut is close for Stanford snow (79.9 percent misses by 0.1 point), so show every station's share instead of hiding the near misses. 3) Caveat words (plain): 'This reading is from {station}, about {miles} miles from this address. A station reading is at the station, not at this address. Snow and rain can differ a lot over a short distance.' Missing: '{station} reported {element} on {n} of {days} days from {start} to {end}. Days it did not report are left blank, not counted as zero.' SNOTEL: '{station} is a SNOTEL site. It reports snow depth, not snowfall.' Stale: 'The newest report from {station} is dated {date}.' None found: 'No station within 40 miles has enough reports for {element} from 2020 to 2025.' 4) Contract row: see the contract field. 5) SNODAS: do not start a backfill; the five-year total is about 22 GB (sample range 4.8 to 45 GB), about 4.4 GB a year.

contract_row_draft.name: ghcn_daily
contract_row_draft.what: NOAA GHCN-Daily station observations: snow depth (SNWD), snowfall (SNOW), precipitation (PRCP), daily maximum and minimum temperature (TMAX, TMIN)
contract_row_draft.mirror_url: https://noaa-ghcn-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/csv/by_station/{station_id}.csv (not current for WBAN and SNOTEL files: last date 2025-02-06 as of 2026-10-19)

units.PRCP: tenths of mm (divide by 10 for mm)

contract_row_draft.missing: .dly VALUE -9999 means missing; the csv has no row for a missing day (no -9999 rows found in five csv files); a missing day is never zero
contract_row_draft.quality: Q-flag blank means the value passed; any other Q-flag means it failed a QA check: exclude from totals, records and unflagged coverage. M-flag T is a trace: 0 in sums, counted as reported.
contract_row_draft.source_flags_seen_in_montana: N = CoCoRaHS; W = WBAN ASOS summary of the day (ISD); 0 = COOP summary of the day; T = SNOTEL; 1 = CF6 (NWS); X = first-order summary; Z = Datzilla addition; D = short-delay CF6 (High Plains RCC). S (GSOD) does not occur in SNOW or PRCP for the 45 candidate stations.
contract_row_draft.timing: Real-time values are replaced by archive-quality values about 45 to 60 days after month end (NCEI product page); show the newest report date with each value
contract_row_draft.cadence: Daily: NCEI .dly Last-Modified 2026-10-18 for all 481 Montana files; latest data 2026-10-16. Freshness rule (proposed): station not current when newest report is older than 30 days.
contract_row_draft.inventory: ghcnd-inventory.txt FIRSTYEAR and LASTYEAR are the first and last year of unflagged data (a range, not coverage). Compute coverage from days.
contract_row_draft.licence: NOAA data via NODD: Creative Commons CC0 1.0 per https://registry.opendata.aws/noaa-ghcn/ (no restrictions on use). No licence text found on the NCEI product page.
tests: flag handling: non-blank Q-flag excluded; trace counted as 0 in sums
-9999 and absent rows are missing, never zero
units converted once: SNOW and SNWD mm; PRCP and TMAX/TMIN tenths
stale station state when newest report older than 30 days
two-nearest rule per element with coverage shares shown

facts.claim: Station cross-check, 2025 rain and temperature, Billings sample point
facts.value: Precipitation 2025: Billings Logan 18.30 in (365 days), Billings WTP COOP USC00240802 18.32 in (363 days), Billings WFO COOP USC00240801 19.26 in (365 days): within about 1 inch. CoCoRaHS US1MTYS0041 20.77 in (358 days) and US1MTYS0046 14.10 in (343 days) differ by 6.7 in from each other. Mean TMAX 2025: airport 60.3 F, WTP 62.3 F, WFO 63.2 F. Mean TMIN 2025: airport 38.4 F, WTP 36.6 F, WFO 37.0 F. Record low 2020 to 2025: airport -25.8 F, WTP -35.6 C (-32.1 F), WFO -35.0 C (-31.0 F), all three on 2024-01-13; the valley COOP sites are colder than the airport on the same night (elevations 944 m and 971 m vs 1,094 m).
facts.evidence: NCEI .dly files USW00024033, USC00240802, USC00240801, US1MTYS0041, US1MTYS0046; outputs/cross_check.json

facts.claim: Station cross-check, 2025 rain and temperature, Benchland sample point
facts.value: Precipitation 2025: Stanford COOP USC00247864 15.53 in (354 days); Lewistown 42 WSW CRN USW00004140 17.84 in (365 days); Lewistown 11 SSE COOP USC00244978 27.87 in (364 days); Crystal Lake SNOTEL USS0009C01S 47.93 in (365 days, elevation 1,844 m). Mean TMIN 2025: Stanford 33.2 F, Lewistown 42 WSW 28.4 F, Lewistown 11 SSE 31.8 F, Crystal Lake 28.3 F. 2020 to 2025 lows: Stanford -37.8 C (-36.0 F, 2024-01-15); Lewistown 42 WSW -44.1 C (-47.4 F, 2024-01-13); Lewistown 11 SSE -38.9 C (-38.0 F, 2024-01-13). The 27.9 in at Lewistown 11 SSE against 17.8 in at Lewistown 42 WSW, 41 miles apart, shows precipitation can differ a lot between stations in one area.
facts.evidence: NCEI .dly files for the four stations; outputs/cross_check.json

facts.claim: Billings WFO COOP record high disagrees with nearby stations on the same day
facts.value: USC00240801 BILLINGS WFO reads TMAX 43.9 C (111.0 F) on 2021-07-19 (S-flag 7, no Q-flag). The same day: Billings Logan 41.7 C (417 tenths), WTP 37.2 C. Its 2021-07-16 to 07-22 values sit in the 35 to 44 C range. Treat the WFO record as unconfirmed until checked; it is the highest 2020 to 2025 reading in the Billings group.
facts.evidence: NCEI .dly USC00240801 (parsed), USW00024033 and USC00240802 on 2021-07-19

terms.source: NOAA GHCN-D on AWS Open Data Registry (NODD)
terms.quote: The NODD team is working on improving performance and access to the GHCNd data and will be implementing an updated prefix structure.
terms.reading: The S3 layout may change; the job should not hard-code prefixes without a check.

terms.quote: Generally, real-time replacement of updated data streams are replaced by archive-ready data sources 45 to 60 days after the end of a month.
terms.reading: Recent values may change for about 45 to 60 days after month end; show the newest date.

terms.quote: Active U.S. stations in GHCNd have updates both via real-time data feeds and via time-delay, archive-quality data feeds.
terms.reading: Some recent values are real-time; the readme's source flags say which feed.

terms.quote: NCEI is currently moving its data and applications to the cloud. This upgrade may result in temporary data access delays.
terms.reading: Banner as fetched 2026-10-19; a possible cause of delayed or stale copies is not confirmed.

terms.quote: VALUE1 is the value on the first day of the month (missing = -9999).
terms.reading: In .dly files -9999 is the missing value.

terms.quote: QFLAG1 is the quality flag for the first day of the month. There are fourteen possible values: Blank = did not fail any quality assurance check
terms.reading: A blank Q-flag means the value passed; any other letter means it failed a check. Whitespace collapsed; wording unchanged.

terms.quote: T     = trace of precipitation, snowfall, or snow depth
terms.reading: A trace is a real but tiny amount; counted as 0 in sums here. Whitespace collapsed; wording unchanged.

terms.quote: NOTE: "S" values are derived from hourly synoptic reports exchanged on the Global Telecommunications System (GTS). Daily values derived in this fashion may differ significantly from "true" daily data, particularly for precipitation (i.e., use with caution).
terms.reading: Source flag S (GSOD) needs a caveat; none of the 45 candidates has S values in SNOW or PRCP for 2020 to 2025. Whitespace collapsed; wording unchanged.

terms.quote: FIRSTYEAR is the first year of unflagged data for the given element.
terms.reading: Inventory years are unflagged-data ranges, not coverage.

terms.quote: LASTYEAR is the last year of unflagged data for the given element.
all files are updated daily for the entire period of record.
terms.reading: Not true in S3 for 114 Montana SNOTEL and WBAN files as of 2026-10-19 (see facts).

terms.quote: A critical system failure at NCEI is preventing updates to GHCN daily, including the by_station files.
terms.reading: Dated April 25, 2021: a historic notice; it does not explain the 2025-02-06 stop.

terms.quote: As a condition of using these data, you must cite the use of this data set.
terms.reading: Citation is a condition of use; the page gives the citation with DOI 10.7265/N5TB14TC. No other use constraint was found on the page.

terms.quote: Overview Notice: Due to funding limitations, this data set was recently changed to a "Basic" Level of Service.
terms.reading: Service level reduced; NSIDC support for this product may be limited.

open_questions: Why do the S3 by-station files for all SNOTEL and WBAN Montana stations stop at 2025-02-06 while the NCEI .dly files are current? Is it the NODD prefix change or the NCEI cloud migration? Check the GHCN status feed and the parquet/ copy before deciding whether any S3 file is used.

Crystal Lake SNOTEL temperatures differ between S3 csv and NCEI .dly (TMIN: NCEI minus S3 mean -1.2 C on 1,848 days). The .dly is newer; confirm which values the owner should show and record the version.

The 2024-25 season totals (64.3 in at Billings Logan, 47.4 in at Great Falls) are as recorded. They were not checked against an NWS climate product in this run; the three-station February 2025 agreement is not an independent check of totals.

The 80 percent threshold is close for some stations (Stanford snow 79.9 percent). The distribution of coverage across all 481 Montana stations was not computed (it needs the .dly set, 392 MB, or csv.gz for COOP and CoCoRaHS).

The smallest daily file set is not known. Compute the union of the two-nearest-per-element stations over all town and tile centres before choosing between csv.gz and .dly, and check the superghcnd diff files (not examined here).

CoCoRaHS absent days: US1MTYS0041 reports 247 of 365 days in 2024-25 (224 zero days, 23 with snow). Are absent days non-reports or zero-snow days in CoCoRaHS practice? This decides whether coverage penalises snowless months. Not checked against CoCoRaHS documentation.

Snow depth from CoCoRaHS in Montana was not measured across the state; US1MTYS0041 reports depth on 0.3 percent of days. Depth should come from SNOTEL, COOP and airport stations unless a wider check shows otherwise.

SNODAS terms beyond the citation condition and any NOHRSC point-query product were not verified (NOHRSC /snodas/ is 404, the NSIDC citation-policy page is 404, /nsa/ has no SNODAS terms). A five-year backfill would be about 21.8 GB, so it is not practical here; if gridded snow is wanted later, plan a separate budget and a per-point extraction method.
NCEI product page has no licence sentence; the CC0 text is on the AWS registry page for NODD. The owner may want an NOAA data policy quote for the About page; not fetched in this run.

Judith Basin: no station near Benchland reported in 2025 (Judith Gap stations end 2021 to 2023). Crystal Lake SNOTEL (31.3 mi) and Stanford COOP (10.9 mi) are the nearest active stations for the Benchland point.
RAWS stations (109 in Montana) have no core-element records in 2025 and are not in the daily set; their wind or other elements were not checked.
The inventory counts are ranges. Coverage in this report comes from the files for 45 candidate stations and the 5 named stations only.

Billings WFO COOP reads 43.9 C (111.0 F) on 2021-07-19, when Billings Logan reads 41.7 C and WTP 37.2 C. Check the WFO value (and its S-flag 7 source) against an NWS climate product before any record high is shown for Billings; station records differ by several degrees on the same day.
